predicates.start_state: An existing visible Timeline summary cell is selected, focused, and not editing.
predicates.stop_state: The next deterministic Timeline summary cell is visibly selected, focused, and would receive direct keyboard input.

predicates.start_state: An existing visible Timeline summary cell is selected, focused, and not editing.
predicates.stop_state: The editor for the same record and field is visible and focused with a collapsed caret at the end.

predicates.start_state: An existing visible committed Timeline summary editor is active for the selected record, focused, at a collapsed end caret, and not composing.
predicates.stop_state: The same active editor visibly renders the prior text with one trailing literal x and remains anchored to the same record and field.

predicates.start_state: The default Timeline view has a visible blank row; input supplies the first qualifying non-empty summary value.
predicates.stop_state: The committed row intersects the visible grid viewport with a stable record ID, positive integer row version, and the entered value rendered.
